_note: v2: facades reframed. The v1 prompts produced photographs of buildings - sky above, road below, neighbours at the edges, real perspective depth. These map onto a flat box face, so the wall has to fill the frame completely.
_fix: Three changes: describe the WALL not the BUILDING, name every unwanted element explicitly (sky/ground/street/neighbours/horizon), and demand a camera perpendicular to the surface. The two v1 formulas that already worked ('seamless tileable top down' and 'isolated on black') both succeeded because they constrained space explicitly - these now do the same.
